name: AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX product specifications page
notes: Vendor primary spec page. No publication date is printed on the page, so published is null rather than guessed; the page does print 'Launch Date 12/13/2022'. Verbatim fields used: Compute Units 96, Boost Frequency Up to 2500 MHz, Game Frequency 2300 MHz, Ray Accelerators 96, AI Accelerators 192, Stream Processors 6144, Texture Units 384, ROPs 192, Transistor Count 58 B, Peak Single Precision (FP32 Vector) Performance 61.4 TFLOPs, Peak Half Precision (FP16 Vector) Performance 61.4 TFLOPs, Peak Half Precision (FP16 Matrix) Performance 123 TFLOPs, Peak 8-bit Precision (INT8 Matrix) Performance 123 TOPs, Peak 4-bit Precision (INT4 Matrix) Performance 246 TOPs, Peak Pixel Fill-Rate Up to 480 GP/s, Peak Texture Fill-Rate Up to 960 GT/s, Typical Board Power (Desktop) 355 W, Minimum PSU Recommendation 800W, GPU Memory: AMD Infinity Cache Technology 96 MB, Memory Speed Up to 20 Gbps, Max Memory Size 24 GB, Memory Type GDDR6, Memory Bandwidth Up to 960 GB/s, Effective Memory Bandwidth Up to 3500 GB/s, Length 287 mm, Slots 2.5, Board Type Component, Additional Power Connector 2x8-Pin, OS Support Windows 11/10 64-bit, Ubuntu x86 64-bit, Linux x86 64-bit. IMPORTANT OMISSION ON THIS PAGE: there is NO 'Memory Interface' (bus width) row for this SKU - AMD prints that row on the 9070 XT page but not here. The 384-bit width therefore comes from a different AMD primary (acc-fill-amd-rx-7900-series-launch), and the record's memory_bandwidth_basis field says so. The 'Effective Memory Bandwidth Up to 3500 GB/s' row is AMD's Infinity-Cache-inclusive marketing figure and is NOT recorded as the DRAM bandwidth. Also note this page never names the architecture generation; that comes from acc-fill-amd-rx-7900-series-press-release-rdna3. Accessed 2026-10-03.
